Sam: Heads-up: scheduling a quiet-window mini-cutover tonight 23:45 UTC for router affinity + small routing-rule pin. Deploy bot set. Need rollback gates and smoke owners.
Ivy: Proposal: 4 steps 15% cadence 4m, warmup 10% for 10m. Keep a 5m quiet window after completion.
Marco: Oncall; abort if p95 delta > 200ms for 4m OR 5xx > 0.8% over 3m OR misroute > 0.3% over 10k sessions. Also abort if LB queue avg > 50s.
Sam: Release note blurb: "router: affinity adjust + routing pin (no downtime expected)". I'll publish post-guard.
Deploy Bot: Shift requested by @Sam for 2024-10-11T23:45:00Z. ID shift-20241011-quiet-01. Plan: [10(warm10m),15,15,15,45] cadence_mins=4 watchers=[Marco,Ivy]. Preflight: PASS except split-key pinned=NO.
Sam: Pinning now: `/router pin quiet-20241011` -> OK.
Deploy Bot: split-key pin: OK. Preflight FINAL: PASS. Reminder posted 30m before start.
Deploy Bot: Shift started. step=1 -> 10% warm. metrics: p95=105ms base=95ms delta=10ms err5xx=0.05% misroute=0%
Ivy: smoke auth flows pass.
Deploy Bot: step=2 -> 25% health=ok p95=115ms err5xx=0.08%
Marco: no alerts. holding cadence.
Deploy Bot: step=4 -> 70% health=ok p95=140ms err5xx=0.2% misroute=0.05%
Deploy Bot: step=5 -> 100% complete. shift-20241011-quiet-01 final status: SUCCESS. Quiet watch: 5m.
Sam: Great. Ivy run final smoke at end of watch and I'll unpin after 1h stabilization.
Ivy: final smoke pass.
Deploy Bot: shift closed. Canary seed 1% for 30m.
Marco: Standing down, will reopen if regressions.
Sam: Thanks team. Posting release note to #releases after guard window.
